summary_paragraph: The patient was readmitted with fevers, hypotension, and respiratory distress following recent discharge for MSSA sepsis. He was found to have Pseudomonas pneumonia and persistent pleural effusion, requiring ICU monitoring, antibiotics, and temporary CVVH due to hypotension during dialysis. A thoracentesis was performed, showing inflammatory fluid. Sputum cultures confirmed Pseudomonas, and treatment was continued with piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin, and ciprofloxacin. His anemia was managed with a blood transfusion. He stabilized after 24 hours, resumed regular hemodialysis, and was discharged to an extended care facility on IV antibiotics, with plans for ongoing dialysis, seizure medication adherence, and close monitoring for clinical deterioration.
